result.stdout:
USAGE:
    agentsessions [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    list                      List sessions across agents                       
    rename <AGENT> <ID>       Label a session (stored by this tool only; the    
                              agent's own data is untouched)                    
    clean                     Archive or delete stale sessions (dry run unless  
                              --apply)                                          
    resume <AGENT> <ID>       Resume a session in its agent                     
    transfer <AGENT> <ID>     Hand a session over to another agent              
    restore <ARCHIVED_DIR>    Restore an archived session

        --project <TEXT>       Only sessions whose project path contains this   
                               text                                             
        --older-than <DAYS>    Only sessions inactive for more than this many   
                               days                                             
        --stale                Only stale sessions (older than the stale-days   
                               setting)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Label a session (stored by this tool only; the agent's own data is untouched)

USAGE:
    agentsessions rename <AGENT> <ID> [LABEL] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <AGENT>    claude, codex or copilot                                         
    <ID>       Session id (a unique prefix is enough)                           
    [LABEL]    The label (several words are joined). Omit, or use --clear, to   
               remove it                                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help     Prints help information
        --clear    Remove the label

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Archive or delete stale sessions (dry run unless --apply)

USAGE:
    agentsessions clean [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                 Prints help information                          
        --older-than <DAYS>    Stale threshold in days (default: the stale-days 
                               setting)                                         
        --archive              Move sessions to the archive (default)           
        --delete               Permanently delete sessions (needs --apply; never
                               the default)                                     
        --apply                Actually do it. Without this only the plan is    
                               printed                                          
        --yes                  Skip the confirmation prompt (with --apply)      
        --ids <IDS>            Comma-separated agent:id pairs instead of the    
                               stale sessions

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help          Prints help information                                 
        --to <AGENT>    Target agent to start on the handoff                    
        --polish        Ask the configured model to polish the handoff (opt-in
